summary: Iteration 85 legal-content + consents verification. All 8 backend pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_85.py pass: /api/content/legal returns exactly {refund_terms, service_terms, privacy_policy, marketing_consent} all with updated_at=2026-06-09; refund_terms contains 'no-show' and 'chargeback' items and a tur/aktivite/transfer section; service_terms sections/items cover aracılık, riskli, cayma, sorumluluk, uyuşmazlık; privacy_policy has 10 sections; marketing_consent has 5 sections. POST /api/applications persists consents into visa_applications collection with accepted_at, and optional fields (marketing_email_optin, ad_personalization_optin) stay False when False is sent and True when True is sent. Frontend verified: /gizlilik-politikasi renders data-testid=privacy-policy-page with 10 h2 sections, /ticari-ileti-onami renders data-testid=marketing-consent-page with 5 h2 sections; on both pages h1.left == first body-paragraph.left (201px, 0px diff). Footer testids (footer-privacy-link, footer-refund-link, footer-service-terms-link, footer-marketing-consent-link) point to correct URLs. /iade-kosullari body contains 'no-show'; /hizmet-sozlesmesi body contains 'aracı', 'riskli', 'cayma', 'uyuşmazlık'. Regression: /esim and /seyahat-sigortasi expose plans-*-apply-button and zero qty-plus/store-submit-button/store-checkout-panel; home scrollHeight=6827px at 1920 wide (<7000). /basvuru wizard loads and consent-block is (correctly) not present on Step 1.

service_terms mentions aracılık, riskli aktivite, cayma hakkı istisnası, sorumluluk sınırı, uyuşmazlık

POST /api/applications persists consents (refund_privacy_accepted, service_terms_accepted, marketing_email_optin, ad_personalization_optin, accepted_at) in visa_applications; optional booleans stored as sent (False/True)

/iade-kosullari contains 'no-show' text; /hizmet-sozlesmesi contains aracı, riskli, cayma, uyuşmazlık

Code review of Apply.jsx confirms: data-testid=consent-block wraps 5 checkboxes (kvkk-checkbox, consent-refund-privacy-checkbox, consent-service-terms-checkbox, consent-marketing-checkbox, consent-ads-checkbox), each label wraps a <Link to=... target=_blank> to the correct route (/kvkk, /iade-kosullari + /gizlilik-politikasi, /hizmet-sozlesmesi, /ticari-ileti-onami)

Code review of submitApplication in Apply.jsx confirms mandatory-checkbox guards emit exact Turkish toasts ('İade ve İptal Koşulları ile Gizlilik Politikası'nı onaylamanız gerekir.' / 'Şartlar ve Mesafeli Hizmet Sözleşmesi'ni onaylamanız gerekir.') and return null before POST /applications, so no application row is created when unchecked

AdminApplicationDetail.jsx renders data-testid=admin-consents with 6 rows: KVKK aydınlatma, İade + Gizlilik, Şartlar / sözleşme, WhatsApp bildirimi, Ticari ileti (pazarlama), Reklam eşleştirmesi + 'Onay zamanı' timestamp when accepted_at exists
critical_code_review_comments: consent-marketing-checkbox and consent-ads-checkbox are OPTIONAL by design; Apply.jsx correctly does not enforce them. Verified.
AdminApplicationDetail admin-consents box treats missing a.consents.* as falsy (— row); safe for legacy applications created before the consents field was added.
Consent link Links use React Router <Link to=... target=_blank>; hrefs are correct routes and open in new tab — behavior matches requirement (href check).

Full E2E wizard walkthrough (Steps 1-4 fill + payment submission with/without consents) was not automated in this iteration due to wizard complexity; the mandatory-consent guard is validated via source review and manual_consent_check.py verifies happy-path submission with consents=True. Recommend adding an isolated component test if regression coverage becomes critical.
